title: Original Plum Torte
description: A classic, simple plum torte with a tender buttery cake base and juicy baked plums, famously published by The New York Times.

steps.instruction: Cream sugar and butter together until light and fluffy.
Add flour, baking powder, salt, and eggs, and mix until well combined.
Spread batter into a greased springform pan.
Arrange plum halves skin-side up on top of the batter.
Sprinkle with additional sugar, lemon juice, and cinnamon.
Bake for about 1 hour, until the cake is set and golden.
Cool before serving. Serve plain or with whipped cream.
